digest.component_or_area: op-cert signing + verification (MCP container, enforce/grandfather mechanism)
propositions: The rebar-mcp container must be provisioned to sign op-certs (plan-review and completion-verifier) under the existing pinned env 9f1c8e42 by composing a signer binding from env_id + materialized Ed25519 key and routing both to the op-cert seam during startup.

A plan-review or completion-verifier cert minted by the container signer must verify successfully against the pinned public key in trusted_environments.yaml; an otherwise-identical cert signed by an unregistered key must be rejected.

The enforce/grandfather mechanism must enforce completion-verifier certs only for tickets closed after a configured boundary (opcert_enforce_since) when require_environment is set, while grandfathering (advisory, exit 0) pre-boundary closes; this must be proven via real verify-opcert merge-gate walk against a fixture config.
Unsetting verify.require_environment must revert verify-opcert to advisory everywhere; existing opcert-minted certs must continue to verify (regression oracle).

The authoritative flip of verify.require_environment and verify.opcert_enforce_since in rebar.toml must be deferred to a human-run operator runbook (not committed in this stack) to prevent retroactive enforcement failures on LOCAL-CLI closes before the MCP signer becomes the merge-gate path.
The MCP container signing provisioning must be fully additive and reversible with no new env/key material, no committed private keys, and no change to trusted_environments.yaml.
